claims.claim_text: The logic module defined GamePhase = 'start' | 'playing' | 'victory' | 'defeat' and AbyssalWellState with player(angle, rotationDir, lives, lastFireTime), enemies(angle/depth continuous), projectiles, sentence, words, targetIndex, correctWords, totalAttempts, gameTime, difficulty, creatureType.
claims.interpretation: Single-scene tube-shooter state model; angles are continuous radians (not lane-snapped) per the Story S5 doc comment at lines 10-16.

claims.claim_text: createAbyssalWellState throws on empty sentences, picks one sentence via injectable RNG, splits term into words, and initializes phase 'start', player angle 1.5π (bottom of rim), 3 lives, no enemies.
claims.interpretation: Deterministic construction with rng injection; default difficulty 'medium', default creature 'cave-spider'.

claims.claim_text: AbyssalWellScene.tsx is the pure R3F render layer (no Canvas/logic/effects): wireframe cylinder tube with one radial segment per lane, depth-glow floor circle, icosahedron enemies with drei Text word labels, sphere projectiles, cone player ship.
claims.interpretation: Scene graph as implemented at the deletion parent. NOTE: this file references enemy.lane, projectile.lane and player.lane (lines 54, 83, 91) which do not exist on the cycling-words state model (angle-based) — see AW-HIST-096.

claims.claim_text: wellProjection.ts maps (lane, depth) onto the tube wall: WELL = {radius 2.2, length 24, lanes from config (8)}; rim (depth 1) at z=0, far end at z=-24; lane angles wrap modulo lane count starting at -90°.
claims.interpretation: Projection helper mirrored from the pre-redesign lane semantics; still lane-based at the deletion parent.

claims.claim_text: startGame transitions phase 'start'->'playing', resets the clock, and spawns every word of the sentence at once at random angles with depths scattered in the lower half of the well (depth = rng()*0.5).
claims.interpretation: Spawn placement carries no word-order information (per doc comment); all words circulate simultaneously.

claims.claim_text: resolveHits transitions phase to 'defeat' when lives reach 0 (wrong-word hits decrement lives; lives floored at 0).
claims.interpretation: Only wrong-order hits cost lives; reaching the rim ('breach') never damages (see AW-HIST-031).

claims.claim_text: checkVictoryCondition transitions phase 'playing'->'victory' when targetIndex >= words.length, i.e. all words collected in order.
claims.interpretation: Terminal victory transition of the cycling-words rules.

claims.claim_text: The React shell mirrored logic phases into UI phases 'start'|'playing'|'ended': victory/defeat triggered results computation (accuracy = correctWords/totalAttempts, XP via calculateXP) and exactly one onComplete report via hasReportedRef.
claims.interpretation: UI-level transition wiring at the deletion parent; restart returns to 'start' (lines 265-268).

claims.claim_text: The implemented ruleset was 'cycling-words' (Story S5, r3f_rendering_tier_20260708): every word circulates in the well; the student derives order from the translation; wrong hits cost lives; rim breaches wrap harmlessly and speed up each lap; motion is smooth continuous radians.
claims.interpretation: Rules doc comment embedded in the logic module at the deletion parent.

claims.claim_text: updateEnemies moves enemies toward the rim at creatureSpeed/gameHeight per second scaled by (1 + laps*0.15); on reaching depth>=1 the enemy wraps to the deep end and laps increments — breach is harmless, each lap is 15% faster.
claims.interpretation: Contradicts the original 2026-03-20 design doc ('enemy reaching rim = lose life') — the S5 redesign explicitly removed breach damage. Flagged for the mapper as a spec-vs-implementation conflict.

claims.claim_text: calculateXP: 0 XP if no attempts; accuracy = correctWords/totalAttempts; base XP = correctWords; +2 perfect accuracy, +1 survival (lives/initial >= 0.5), +1 speed (gameTime < 30s); total clamped to max 10.
claims.interpretation: Implemented XP formula differs from the 2026-03-20 design doc (correctWords*10 + accuracy*50 + time bonus, clamped 1-10). Recorded as conflict for the mapper.
claims.conflict_state: conflicts-with-design-doc AW-HIST-098; implementation is the later, authoritative revision

claims.claim_text: ABYSSAL_WELL_CONFIG: gameWidth 390, gameHeight 700, 8 lanes, rimRadius 120, wellDepth 5; player fireRate 300ms, projectileSpeed 400, radius 18, rotationSpeed 2.4 rad/s, angularHitTolerance π/8; enemy baseSpeed 50, radius 20, wordOrbRadius 25, lapSpeedup 0.15; lives 3.
claims.interpretation: Tuning constants at the deletion parent. lanes/rimRadius/wellDepth are legacy lane-model fields retained after the S5 continuous-angle redesign.

claims.claim_text: Three difficulties — easy 'Shallow Well' (4 words), medium 'Deep Chasm' (5), hard 'Abyss' (6) — and three creature speeds — goblin-scout 50, cave-spider 70, shadow-demon 90 — with medium/cave-spider fallbacks in getDifficultyConfig/getCreatureSpeed.
claims.interpretation: Difficulty/creature selection surfaced on the start screen (AbyssalWellGame.tsx lines 221-248).

claims.claim_text: On completion the page posted to /api/v1/games/abyssal-well/complete with xpEarned, accuracy, correctAnswers = floor(accuracy*10), totalAttempts = 10, userId; it also wrote xp/accuracy to useGameStore.setLastResult.
claims.interpretation: Client-reported totals (hardcoded totalAttempts 10) — the client-trusted-XP pattern later flagged program-wide (schema.ts strict() comment).

claims.claim_text: Keyboard controls during play: ArrowLeft/A rotate counter-clockwise, ArrowRight/D rotate clockwise, Space/Enter fire (preventDefault); input ignored unless playing.
